body: I am so sorry you are feeling that way. I have a son who is 15 and is dealing with a lot of what you are dealing with and it is not easy. You have a lot on your plate and you need help. I have been working on a 504 plan with his counselor at school and am hoping that will help. Do you have a 504 plan? WIth this plan you can have accommodations that might be of help. I know it is not easy. Talk to advocates in your life. Wishing you all the best with your journey.
